attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt router) to serve DHCP on its second interface (eth1, 192.168.50.0/24) shared with node2 and node3. node2 (MAC 02:70:a4:8a:94:63) has a static DHCP host reservation always giving it 192.168.50.50; node3 is served from the general dynamic pool (192.168.50.100-199, currently .175). Verified repeatability by releasing/renewing node2's lease twice (same IP both times), then restarted all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery of the DHCP service, static reservation, and pool addressing afterward.
